name: obsidian-manuscript-compiler
description: Compile an Obsidian vault into a print-ready manuscript (PDF + DOCX) via SuperDocs.

scripts.build: npm run clean --silent && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.demo: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.mjs compile demo-vault --out build --offline
scripts.demo:export: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.mjs compile demo-vault --out build --format pdf,docx,html
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run demo && npm run scale --silent
scripts.scale: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.mjs scale

author: Elizabeth Sobiya
